summary: The `stellar.toml` file is used to provide a common place where the Internet can find information about your organization’s Stellar integration. By setting the home_domain of your Stellar account to the domain that hosts your `stellar.toml`, you can create a definitive link between this information and that account. Any website can publish Stellar network information, and the `stellar.toml` is designed to be readable by both humans and machines. If you are an anchor or issuer, the `stellar.toml` file serves a very important purpose: it allows you to publish information about your organization and token(s) that help to legitimize your offerings. Clients and exchanges can use this information to decide whether a token should be listed. Fully and truthfully disclosing contact and business information is an essential step in responsible token issuance. If you are a validator, the `stellar.toml` file allows you to declare your node(s) to other network participants, which improves discoverability, and contributes to the health and decentralization of the network as a whole.

fields.name: VERSION
fields.description: The version of SEP-1 your `stellar.toml` adheres to. This helps parsers know which fields to expect.

fields.name: NETWORK_PASSPHRASE
fields.description: The passphrase for the specific [Stellar network](https://developers.stellar.org/docs/networks) this infrastructure operates on

fields.name: FEDERATION_SERVER
fields.description: The endpoint for clients to resolve stellar addresses for users on your domain via [SEP-2](sep-0002.md) Federation Protocol

fields.name: AUTH_SERVER
fields.description: (deprecated) The endpoint used for [SEP-3](sep-0003.md) Compliance Protocol

fields.name: TRANSFER_SERVER
fields.description: The server used for [SEP-6](sep-0006.md) Anchor/Client interoperability

fields.name: TRANSFER_SERVER_SEP0024
fields.description: The server used for [SEP-24](sep-0024.md) Anchor/Client interoperability

fields.name: KYC_SERVER
fields.description: The server used for [SEP-12](sep-0012.md) Anchor/Client customer info transfer

fields.name: WEB_AUTH_ENDPOINT
fields.description: The endpoint used for [SEP-10 Web Authentication](sep-0010.md)

fields.name: WEB_AUTH_FOR_CONTRACTS_ENDPOINT
fields.description: The endpoint used for [SEP-45 Web Authentication](sep-0045.md)

fields.name: WEB_AUTH_CONTRACT_ID
fields.description: The web authentication contract ID for [SEP-45 Web Authentication](sep-0045.md)

fields.name: SIGNING_KEY
fields.description: The signing key is used for [SEP-3](sep-0003.md) Compliance Protocol (deprecated) and [SEP-10](sep-0010.md)/[SEP-45](sep-0045.md) Authentication Protocols

fields.name: HORIZON_URL
fields.description: Location of public-facing Horizon instance (if you offer one)

fields.name: ACCOUNTS
fields.description: A list of Stellar accounts that are controlled by this domain

fields.name: URI_REQUEST_SIGNING_KEY
fields.description: The signing key is used for [SEP-7](sep-0007.md) delegated signing

fields.name: DIRECT_PAYMENT_SERVER
fields.description: The server used for receiving [SEP-31](sep-0031.md) direct fiat-to-fiat payments. Requires [SEP-12](sep-0012.md) and hence a `KYC_SERVER` TOML attribute.

fields.name: ANCHOR_QUOTE_SERVER
fields.description: The server used for receiving [SEP-38](sep-0038.md) requests.

fields.name: ORG_NAME
fields.description: Legal name of your organization

fields.name: ORG_DBA
fields.description: (may not apply) [DBA](https://www.entrepreneur.com/encyclopedia/doing-business-as-dba) of your organization

fields.name: ORG_URL
fields.description: Your organization's official URL. Your `stellar.toml` must be hosted on the same domain.

fields.name: ORG_LOGO
fields.description: A PNG image of your organization's logo on a transparent background

fields.name: ORG_DESCRIPTION
fields.description: Short description of your organization

fields.name: ORG_PHYSICAL_ADDRESS
fields.description: Physical address for your organization

fields.name: ORG_PHYSICAL_ADDRESS_ATTESTATION
fields.description: URL on the same domain as your `ORG_URL` that contains an image or pdf official document attesting to your physical address. It must list your `ORG_NAME` or `ORG_DBA` as the party at the address. Only documents from an official third party are acceptable. E.g. a utility bill, mail from a financial institution, or business license.

fields.name: ORG_PHONE_NUMBER
fields.description: Your organization's phone number in [E.164 format](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/E.164), e.g. `+14155552671`. See also [this guide](https://support.twilio.com/hc/en-us/articles/223183008-Formatting-International-Phone-Numbers).

fields.name: ORG_PHONE_NUMBER_ATTESTATION
fields.description: URL on the same domain as your `ORG_URL` that contains an image or pdf of a phone bill showing both the phone number and your organization's name.

fields.name: ORG_KEYBASE
fields.description: A [Keybase](https://keybase.io/) account name for your organization. Should contain proof of ownership of any public online accounts you list here, including your organization's domain.

fields.name: ORG_TWITTER
fields.description: Your organization's Twitter account

fields.name: ORG_GITHUB
fields.description: Your organization's Github account

fields.name: ORG_OFFICIAL_EMAIL
fields.description: An email that business partners such as wallets, exchanges, or anchors can use to contact your organization. Must be hosted at your `ORG_URL` domain.

fields.name: ORG_SUPPORT_EMAIL
fields.description: An email that users can use to request support regarding your Stellar assets or applications.

fields.name: ORG_LICENSING_AUTHORITY
fields.description: Name of the authority or agency that issued a license, registration, or authorization to your organization, if applicable

fields.name: ORG_LICENSE_TYPE
fields.description: Type of financial or other license, registration, or authorization your organization holds, if applicable

fields.name: ORG_LICENSE_NUMBER
fields.description: Official license, registration, or authorization number of your organization, if applicable

fields.name: name
fields.description: Full legal name

fields.name: email
fields.description: Business email address for the principal

fields.name: keybase
fields.description: Personal Keybase account. Should include proof of ownership for other online accounts, as well as the organization's domain.

fields.name: telegram
fields.description: Personal Telegram account

fields.name: twitter
fields.description: Personal Twitter account

fields.name: github
fields.description: Personal Github account

fields.name: id_photo_hash
fields.description: SHA-256 hash of a photo of the principal's government-issued photo ID

fields.name: verification_photo_hash
fields.description: SHA-256 hash of a verification photo of principal. Should be well-lit and contain: principal holding ID card and signed, dated, hand-written message stating `I, $NAME, am a principal of $ORG_NAME, a Stellar token issuer with address $ISSUER_ADDRESS.`

fields.name: code
fields.description: Token code. Required.

fields.name: issuer
fields.description: Stellar public key of the issuing account. Required for tokens that are Stellar Assets. Omitted if the token is not a Stellar asset.

fields.name: contract
fields.description: Contract ID of the token contract. The token must be compatible with the [SEP-41 Token Interface](sep-0041.md) to be defined here. Required for tokens that are not Stellar Assets. Omitted if the token is a Stellar Asset.

fields.name: code_template
fields.description: A pattern with `?` as a single character wildcard. Allows a `[[CURRENCIES]]` entry to apply to multiple assets that share the same info. An example is futures, where the only difference between issues is the date of the contract. E.g. `CORN????????` to match codes such as `CORN20180604`.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Status of token. One of `live`, `dead`, `test`, or `private`. Allows issuer to mark whether token is dead/for testing/for private use or is live and should be listed in live exchanges.

fields.name: display_decimals
fields.description: Preference for number of decimals to show when a client displays currency balance

fields.name: name
fields.description: A short name for the token

fields.name: desc
fields.description: Description of token and what it represents

fields.name: conditions
fields.description: Conditions on token

fields.name: image
fields.description: URL to a PNG image on a transparent background representing token

fields.name: fixed_number
fields.description: Fixed number of tokens, if the number of tokens issued will never change

fields.name: max_number
fields.description: Max number of tokens, if there will never be more than `max_number` tokens

fields.name: is_unlimited
fields.description: The number of tokens is dilutable at the issuer's discretion

fields.name: is_asset_anchored
fields.description: `true` if token can be redeemed for underlying asset, otherwise `false`

fields.name: anchor_asset_type
fields.description: Type of asset anchored. Can be `fiat`, `crypto`, `nft`, `stock`, `bond`, `commodity`, `realestate`, or `other`.

fields.name: anchor_asset
fields.description: If anchored token, code / symbol for asset that token is anchored to. E.g. USD, BTC, SBUX, Address of real-estate investment property.

fields.name: attestation_of_reserve
fields.description: URL to attestation or other proof, evidence, or verification of reserves, such as third-party audits.

fields.name: redemption_instructions
fields.description: If anchored token, these are instructions to redeem the underlying asset from tokens.

fields.name: collateral_addresses
fields.description: If this is an anchored crypto token, list of one or more public addresses that hold the assets for which you are issuing tokens.

fields.name: collateral_address_messages
fields.description: Messages stating that funds in the `collateral_addresses` list are reserved to back the issued asset. See below for details.

fields.name: collateral_address_signatures
fields.description: These prove you control the `collateral_addresses`. For each address you list, sign the entry in `collateral_address_messages` with the address's private key and add the resulting string to this list as a base64-encoded raw signature.

fields.name: regulated
fields.description: indicates whether or not this is a [sep0008](https://github.com/stellar/stellar-protocol/blob/master/ecosystem/sep-0008.md) regulated asset. If missing, `false` is assumed.

fields.name: approval_server
fields.description: url of a [sep0008](https://github.com/stellar/stellar-protocol/blob/master/ecosystem/sep-0008.md) compliant approval service that signs validated transactions.

fields.name: approval_criteria
fields.description: a human readable string that explains the issuer's requirements for approving transactions.

fields.name: toml
fields.description: Alternately, stellar.toml can link out to a separate TOML file for each currency by specifying toml as the currency's only field

fields.name: ALIAS
fields.description: A name for display in stellar-core configs that conforms to `^[a-z0-9-]{2,16}$`

fields.name: DISPLAY_NAME
fields.description: A human-readable name for display in quorum explorers and other interfaces

fields.name: PUBLIC_KEY
fields.description: The Stellar account associated with the node

fields.name: HOST
fields.description: The IP:port or domain:port peers can use to connect to the node

fields.name: HISTORY
fields.description: The location of the history archive published by this validator
